analysis_rationale: The patch adds an immediate error-path barrier after `dynrelcount = bfd_canonicalize_dynamic_reloc (abfd, dynrelbuf, dynsyms);`. Before the fix, the returned `dynrelcount` flowed directly into `qsort (dynrelbuf, dynrelcount, sizeof (arelent *), compare_relocs);` with no check. The new `if (dynrelcount < 0) return -1;` shows the dangerous mechanism is continued consumption of a negative/error count as the element count for a sorting operation. The diff does not by itself prove the exact downstream memory-failure class, so the main label should remain `unknown`, but the patch-local semantics clearly indicate missing validation of a count/size value before a memory-manipulating sink.
